method: Custom scoped engineering assessment, not gstack composite or whole-project health score

decisions.interpretation_semantics: Typed, cited, number-free; bounded guards, not universal entailment
decisions.fusion: Thin validated derived-evidence adapter; existing financial weights unchanged
decisions.dashboard: Backend presentation adapter; textContent rendering; no raw schema dependency
decisions.ledger: Validation then durable ledger then cache/publication
decisions.legacy: Historical contracts and artifacts preserved; test-only compatibility harness

tradeoffs: Existing broad harness/server ownership remains architectural debt.
Legacy compatibility increases test maintenance but prevents rewriting historical meaning.
Qualitative support is not calibrated statistical confidence.
